sentences.text:
This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 29.05.2024 as well as cognizance/summoning order dated 24.06.2024 and the entire proceeding of Criminal Case No.5879/9 of 2024, arising out of Case Crime No.0023 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Mahila Thana,
District-Shamli, pending before Civil Judge (J.D.)/F.T.C., Shamli.
Irshad
And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111635501/

entities.text: 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the applicants submits that applicant no.3 is the husband of opposite party no.2 and applicant nos.1 and 2 are father and mother of applicant no.3.
The marriage between two were solemnized in the year 2014.
He further submits that after 10 years of the marriage, the FIR was lodged on 29.04.2024 against the husband and his family members.
He further submits that there is a matrimonial dispute between husband and wife and the entire family members have been falsely implicated.

He further submits that now a days the provision of Section 498-A IPC is being used as weapon of harassment, because this is the simplest way to harass and get the husband and his other relatives arrested by leveling frivolous allegations against them.

In support of his contention,
learned counsel for the applicant has placed reliance upon the judgment of Hon'ble the Apex Court in the case of Geeta Mehrotra and another vs State of U.P. and another, 2012 (10) SCC 741.

entities.text: Geeta Mehrotra and another vs State of U.P. and another, 2012 (10) SCC 741
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, the matter requires consideration.

Notice on behalf of opposite party no. 1 has been accepted by learned A.G.A.
Issue notice to opposite party no.2 returnable at an early date.
Opposite party no.2 may file counter affidavit within four weeks.
Learned A.G.A. may also file counter affidavit within the same period.
Rejoinder affidavit may thereafter be filed within two weeks.
List immediately after expiry of the aforesaid period before appropriate Bench.

Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant nos.1&2, namely,
Irshad and Smt. Naseema herein in the aforesaid case.
However, the prayer in respect of the applicant no.3 Gufran is refused.

It is directed that if applicant no.3 appears and surrenders before the concerned court below within four weeks from today and applies for bail, his prayer for bail shall be considered and decided expeditiously in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in (2021) 10 SCC 773
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
For the period of four weeks from today or till the disposal of bail application, whichever is earlier,
no coercive action shall be taken against him.
However, in case, he does not appear before the Court below within the aforesaid period, coercive action shall be taken against him.
This application at the behest of applicant no.1 stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 6.11.2024 Rahul.
